evals.name: stand-up-platform-live
evals.prompt: Make my kind cluster observable - context kind-noto-smoke. Stand up the whole noto stack on it.
evals.expected_output: Runs noto platform --cluster noto-smoke with --dry-run first (a cluster the agent did not create), reads the report, then the real run. All helm steps install from pins; the validate step asserts every pod Running/Succeeded. On re-run, done steps skip (idempotency). Does not delete the ledger.
assertions: A --dry-run run happens before the real run
The real run completes with the validate step passing
A second run skips already-done steps instead of reinstalling
No helm install/upgrade is run by hand outside the step engine

evals.name: failed-step-resume-judgment
evals.prompt: noto platform failed halfway with a helm timeout on the mimir step yesterday. What do I do - wipe the ledger and start over?
evals.expected_output: No: the ledger is the audit trail and the engine resumes. Read the recorded error, fix the cause (quota, kube context, values), re-run the same command - done steps skip, the failed step retries. Explicitly refuses the ledger wipe.
assertions: Points at the ledger's recorded error as the diagnosis start
Prescribes re-running the same command for resume semantics
